status: partial historical model profile; architecture reference only

guidance_computer.note: Apollo 11 1201/1202 Executive-overflow meanings, software-restart behavior, and P63/P64 restart protection are source-backed; exact real-time workload state, display path, and complete alarm-response rule set remain incomplete.

backup_guidance.note: PGNS/AGS independent cross-check value is documented operationally and generic pairwise comparison machinery is implemented; exact Apollo 11 fields, controller-visible values, freshness rules, and comparison tolerances remain unfrozen.

landing_radar.note: Mission Report timing for radar-good state and radar-update enablement is sourced. Generic data-good/update-enable/channel/velocity-threshold gating is implemented; LM-5 measurement generation, reasonability tests, weighting/filter equations, cadence, and controller presentation remain unresolved.

propulsion.note: Generic variable-thrust machinery exists, but Apollo 11 LM-5 powered-descent thrust/mass-flow profile and historical acceptance inputs are not yet frozen for this reference interval.

translational_dynamics.note: Generic central-gravity propagation exists, but Apollo 11 descent frame, initial state, lunar gravity/perturbation scope, thrust-direction coupling, and validation tolerance are not yet frozen.

controller_observation.note: Alarm chronology and selected controller/crew communications are documented; exact GUIDO display fields, update cadence, and independent PGNS/AGS/radar observation products remain incomplete.

guidance_monitoring.note: Apollo 11 powered-descent monitoring used PGNCS, AGS, and MSFN velocity comparisons with two-out-of-three logic and premission residual redlines. Generic multi-source consensus machinery is implemented; exact phase/source-pair fields, redlines, cadence, MSFN processor behavior, and controller presentation remain incomplete.
